# BS ↔ AD date converter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/bs-ad-converter/

Convert supported Bikram Sambat and Gregorian calendar dates locally. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Convert a supported Nepali date to Gregorian and round-trip the result back to BS.

## Limits and checks

Conversion uses a bundled calendar table with a displayed supported range. Dates outside that table are rejected rather than guessed.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.

## Method and sources

- [Nepali Date — bundled MIT calendar data, version 3.4.0](https://github.com/subeshb1/Nepali-Date)
